text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: prometheus.scrape.down fired for cluster-prod (severity: P1)
pagerduty: Incident PD-4821 created and notified on-call team
jen_oncall: acked — taking initial triage (on-call:jen) :wave:
jen_oncall: what are we seeing? any customers affected?
mike_sre: prometheus targets show repeated connection timeouts to node-exporter + kubelet on a subset of nodes, scrape success rate dropped from 99% -> 62% in last 6m
sam_infra: also seeing log ingest queue growing on log-collector-0..3, backpressure kicking in, Kafka consumer lag rising
lisa_prod: dashboards for inference-serving are missing `latency_p99` and `request_rate` for several services — likely due to missing scrape metrics
jen_oncall: ok, scope: prometheus scrapes failing -> missing metrics -> alerting + dashboards broken + logs lagging. potential customer impact: observability gaps and delayed alerts. start mitigations
jen_oncall: action 1: restart prometheus-scrape-exporter on cluster-prod-a (will do now)
jen_oncall: `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/prometheus-scrape-exporter --context prod-a`
ops-bot: deploy job enqueued: restart prometheus-scrape-exporter (initiated by jen_oncall)
mike_sre: meanwhile, check iptables / network policy changes? I saw a recent netpol rollout 35m ago from sam_infra
sam_infra: confirming: we rolled out a tightened egress netpol to 10.5.0.0/16 for security earlier — that could block prometheus pull from nodes. rolling back on prod-a now to test
sam_infra: `kubectl patch networkpolicy deny-everything -n default --type=json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/egress"}]'`
jen_oncall: good call. if rollback helps, plan for a safe netpol that allows kubelet/node-exporter scrape ports (9100, 10250) to prometheus PODs
lisa_prod: customer impact: we should prepare a status page note: degraded metrics for infra observability, not user-facing inference queries yet but could mask failures — we should flag that to SRE/CS
jen_oncall: creating incident ticket IR-2026 and status update draft
jen_oncall: status draft: "We are investigating degraded metrics collection in prod. Metric dashboards may be incomplete and alerts may be delayed. Engineers are working on network policy and scraper restarts."
mike_sre: prometheus exporter pods restarted on prod-a, scraping returned to normal for ~60% nodes within 30s, still seeing failures on prod-b and prod-c
sam_infra: rollback applied to prod-b now, prod-c next. applying a targeted egress allow for prometheus namespace instead of full rollback as a safer long term change
jen_oncall: also noticed prometheus stuck on some TSDB head locks on prod-c — might be separate but could impede scraping queue. opening quick playbook: `kubectl exec -n monitoring prometheus-0 -- curl -s localhost:9090/-/ready`
ops-bot: check-ready returned: false on prometheus-0 (prod-c)
mike_sre: bump replicas? we can scale down/up to force TSDB recovery but that's disruptive. try `promtool tsdb analyze`? don't want longer downtime
jen_oncall: for now, focus on node scrape connectivity; TSDB will be next if dashboards still bad after scrapes restored
lisa_prod: log ingest: consumer lag stayed high while scrapes failed — infra tags missing so routing errors happened. we need to increase log-collector replicas temporarily
sam_infra: scaling log-collector from 4 -> 8 in prod to catch up: `kubectl scale deployment/log-collector --replicas=8 -n logging`
ops-bot: scale job started for deployment/log-collector -> 8 replicas
mike_sre: good, consumers rebalanced, Kafka lag dropping on the consumer group `log-collector-group`
jen_oncall: update: prod-a and prod-b scrapes largely back. prod-c partial: still ~20 nodes failing to scrape. working with infra on a per-node check
sam_infra: found that iptables on those nodes had a stale rule after a security patch. flushing specific rules fixed node-12 and node-17. patching automation to avoid reapplying faulty rule set
jen_oncall: mitigation summary so far: 1) rolled back problematic netpol changes 2) restarted prometheus exporter pods 3) scaled log collectors to drain backlog 4) flushed bad iptables rules on affected nodes 5) monitoring TSDB status — will run deeper check if needed
lisa_prod: customer comms: posting preliminary status on status.redwood.com: "Partial degradation to internal metrics and logging ingestion in_prod; some dashboards and alerts delayed. Engineers mitigating." tag with incident IR-2026 and PD-4821
jen_oncall: any remaining user-visible impacts? any API errors being reported?
mike_sre: no API errors in prod clusters visible. inference engines still answering queries. risk is missed internal alerts and delayed SLA detection
jen_oncall: ok. assign followups: sam_infra to harden netpol rollout process and automation (action item A1). mike_sre to audit prometheus scrape configs and consider adding more robust target fallbacks (A2). lisa_prod to coordinate customer/status comms and post-mortem (A3). I'll continue on-call for 30 more mins then handoff to mike_sre
jen_oncall: timebox: next update in 15m; if things stay green I'll handoff to mike for the overnight shift at 17:30UTC
mike_sre: ack, I'll take handoff at 17:30UTC and monitor TSDB readiness across clusters. will also run `promtool tsdb analyze` on prod-c overnight if needed
lisa_prod: noted. I'll update status page and ping CS for potential impacted customers (no major incidents but keep them informed)
ops-bot: reminder: please add postmortem label and severity to IR-2026 ticket when created
jen_oncall: updating incident ticket with timeline and mitigation steps now
jen_oncall: handing off to mike_sre at 17:30UTC — oncall transfer: jen_oncall -> mike_sre :handoff:
mike_sre: taking over oncall. will post another update at 18:00UTC or sooner if regressions
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert resolved: prometheus.scrape.down cleared for cluster-prod (PD-4821)
jen_oncall: thanks team. final notes: follow-up action items A1/A2/A3 assigned. postmortem to include root cause of netpol change flow, automation bug that reintroduced iptables rule, and TSDB resilience notes.
lisa_prod: will draft postmortem and ping folks for contributions
mike_sre: will include scrape target fallback proposal
jen_oncall: closing thread — moving IR-2026 to monitoring -> postmortem in 24h if no more regressions. :white_check_mark:
